brief: A three-storey cabinet with at least three drawers.

requirements.evidence: Pieces at 0,0,0; 0,0,1; 0,0,2 (half-n variants) forming levels 0-2, verified by get_build and check_build ok, meshClash clear
Three drawers installed: drawer:0#0,0#cut (level 0), drawer:1#0,0#cut (level 1), drawer:2#0,0#cut (level 2) via addDrawer sockets s49-s51

finish.summary: Built three-storey cabinet using half-n pieces stacked vertically with one drawer per level (3 total). Check_build ok, meshClash clear, no errors.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
